hints.content:
The double number lines show that  a hen lays $\blueE{1}$ egg every $\maroonD{25}$ hours.


Eggs| Time (hours)
:-: | :-:
$1$| $25$

The remaining values in the table represent ratios that are equivalent to this ratio.

If the hen lays $3$ times as many eggs, it needs $3$ times as many hours.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The values in the second number line, labeled Time (hours), are 25 times the corresponding values in the first number line, labeled Eggs. The line labeled Eggs, reads from left to right: 0, 1, 3. The line labeled Time (hours), reads from left to right: 0, 25, 75. An arrow from the pair 1 to 25 to the pair 3 to 75 is labeled times 3.

hints.content:
